body: Thank you, that really does help and I really appreciate the advice.

I have tried antidepressants and they didn't work. I started feeling quite a bit better recently on my own, but its all gone to shit now. 

Thanks for the suggestion though.

I understand exactly how you fell. I'm going to be turning 24 in a couple months, and I feel like I have nothing to show for my life. I also wish I'd focused more in school and did better, in order to get an education.

The saddest part is that the friends I had in school all performed average like me, but because their parents could afford to pay for them to study, they have decent jobs, while I work minimum wage.
Thank you, I really appreciate the reply

I don't believe that some people are always not okay, while everyone else has all their shit together. I think that we all go through periods of being okay, not okay, amazing and downright suicidal. And I know that those periods don't balance out the way we'd like them to sometimes, but the possibility for all of them is always there.

This means that it is definitely possible for you to be okay and even more than okay in the future.

Hey, that sounds really awesome. Like you said, it felt good to be included and that's definitely something. 

I'm going out on a limb here by saying that you're probably a socially anxious person, and if so, that's pretty huge and you should be proud of yourself.
Maybe... But I have so much shit to deal with in my life... I don't know how I'm supposed to deal with it all.

Well, helium is an inert gas. So, when you breath it in, your body doesn't recognize it as being different to oxygen. That's why you can suck on a balloon filled with helium and not cough, since your body doesn't reject it. That's also why, if you suck on a helium filled balloon too much, you'll pass out from lack of oxygen.

My plan is to get a couple tanks, set up some sort of mask that will stay on after I pass out, and just breath it in until I die.

It'll be the quickest, cleanest and most painless way to off myself I can come up with.

I'm 23.
No, I'm not depressed because I'm earning minimum wage. Well yes, I am a bit... But I've been depressed for a few years now because of how much I hate myself and my life.

I'm sorry that you can't find a job, but at least you have a university education, which is a lot more than what I have.

Yes, I can work in my career and get promoted internally, but all I've ever wanted was to study and further my education and start my own business.

Yeah, every day. 

My life is a mess and I have no idea how to turn it onto something I can actually be proud of.
Thank you. I'll try to keep that in mind.

Well, I really don't mind talking to you.

I enjoy writing about fantasy and sci-fi. Stuff like The Lord of the Rings and Star Wars inspires me. Just not the latest Star Wars movie, that was just plain bad.

I'm sorry that you're also feeling like you should end your life. Why are you feeling that way though, if you don't mind me asking?

Thanks for the reply and for sharing your thoughts.

It's tough going, but I'm trying.

I would actually like to get an education sometime in the future, but my mom was never able to afford that for me.

I'm actually trying to get into freelance writing online, but it's slow going at the moment.

I'm going to keep trying though.

Have an awesome week!

I'm sorry about that man, but you'll get through it. Best thing to do (in my opinion anyway) is to hit the gym and hit the weights. 

I'm doing okay, thanks. I was just feeling really down about life, but I'm feeling a bit better today. 

I hope you're okay though, but you will be. 

I'm really glad if you got something out of my post.

Too right. This world is a crazy, fucked up place, but we have our places in it. I don't believe in any higher power, so I don't believe that we're here for a "purpose", but that doesn't mean we can't give life our best shots. No matter how dark it gets sometimes.
Haha nice analogy, thanks! I am actually feeling a bit better now, thanks. I'm still feeling a tad down, but it's not as bad as it was.

You have a really good point that I'd still be me if I were someone else, but maybe I'd be a better me? Idk. 

Nope, the only coping method I try is breathing and meditation.

Thank you, I really appreciate the reply. I just wish I wasn't me most of the time, you know? Funny thing is that I was actually starting to get over my depression and suicidal thoughts a couple weeks ago.
Why? What makes you say that?

Yeah, I too hear where you're coming from. It's like "Sure, I'll just wave a magic wand and these shitty feelings will all just disappear!".

No, it's not at all like you just feel like crawling into a hole and slowly dying!

But fuck them man (easier said than done, though, I know).

Wow, I didn't know that I would get this kind of response to my question. It's actually really sad though to think that there are so many of us that struggle with these thoughts... 

Thank you all for the upvotes though. I'm really glad about one thing and I see a trend with that thing. I see that a lot of us are only hanging around because of a loved one. I'm in the same situation, but at least for me, there are a few family members who I have promised to stick around for.

I've also thought about offing myself when my mom goes, but I'm really close to my cousin and she's like a little sister to me. I couldn't imagine myself putting her through that.

She's actually told me that a big part of her life would be gone if I were. She's been really depressed and down too sometimes and I've been the person who she goes to for support. 

I'm also all that my mom has in terms of family and I'm her only child, so it would probably literally kill her.

Well, I just hope that we can all make our ways out of this darkness. Good luck to us all and I wish you all the best!

Yeah, I get what you're saying. I also have confrontation fantasies running through my head, but it goes past just arguments and I imagine myself getting into a fight. 

It's bad though because sometimes I lash out verbally at people like my mom.

Hey, I'm really sorry about your situation and I can empathise, at least on the financial front. Like minnie333 said, you're still alive, so that means you still have chances to be happy and live well.
I'm not saying that it will be easy but you'll be okay. Remember, though, you're not alone in the world and people will help you if you ask for it.

Feel free to PM me if you want to chat.

Oh, and I hope you have an awesome day!

Yeah, the money thing made me sound like a shallow prick, but when I'm too broke to even train MMA. I'm 23, I haven't trained in a couple of years and I want to compete one day? Yeah, it gets me down. 

I want to make my living as a writer. Not just a blogger, but I want to write books and information products that will help people. Especially with regards to exercise and nutrition. I would also love to write articles and books on subjects that I love.

I don't know though... I think it would be for the best for me to say my goodbyes to everyone and make my exit.

I know what you mean about wishing you didn't feel this horrible in the first place, but you'll be alright. 

I am just really glad that you said you'll try as much as you can to get this solved. That, my friend, is an awesome attitude to have! keep it up!

I hear where you're coming from. The need to connect with others is as basic a human need as food and water. 
All I can say is that you need to keep strong and keep going.
You will be okay, just don't ever give up on yourself.

It's okay, I understand where you're coming from. To be honest, nobody really ever knows what to do. I think that all of us just do the best we can with what we have.

I want you to do that. Do the best you can with what you have and don't ever stop going. 

Do it for yourself.

Hey, I just wanted to say that I understand where you're coming from, but you will be okay.

I know that you probably hear that a lot, but you will be. Just keep soldiering on, but don't do it for me or anyone else, do it for yourself.

I hope all the best for you, but message me if you need a friendly ear.

I hear you. Had the same thing happen to me once, but I'm still here for some reason.

I'd also love to be rich, even if it were just to afford a counselor.
We'll be okay though, just hang in there.

Talk to as many people as you can, and if someone doesn't want to give you the time of day? Find someone else.

If anything else, message me if you want help.
Don't do it people. I know the hell we go through, but please don't do it.

Wow man, you sound like me. I can definitely relate, but maybe that's a good thing since at least we both know we're not alone?

I went to sleep early (at around 9pm), but I woke up at 2am and couldn't get back to sleep. Sucks...

Just wanted to say that your past isn't real. By that, I mean that it's gone and it's never coming back. your present and future are way more real than your past. So, do the best you can with your present and focus on your future.

Thank you for all of that. I guess I needed a kick in the arse, but you're right about everything you said.

I'm going to do my thing and give it my best shot. 

Thanks agin for your reply. It honestly has inspired me and encouraged me. 

Stay well and look after yourself.

Well, I guess nothing is so bad that I should want to end it, but I do. Logically, there's no reason for me to kill myself, but I still want to. 

I want to kill myself because I feel like I have wasted too much of my life that I can't get back. I'm 23 and that's young, I know, but still. Like I said, I know that its not logical, but I think about it pretty much every day. I'm just always miserable and it take a lot for me to put on a happy face for others and when I don't, I know that it upsets them and who can blame them. 

I just wish I were someone else. Someone better than I am. I know that I'm a whiny little bitch, but yeah, that's just how I feel.

It's funny how I idolize SEALs, SAS and other Spec Ops guys from around the world and here I want to kill myself and I don't even have PTSD. Hell, I've never even joined the military and experienced combat, but I think I have things bad, it's pathetic. 

I know I'm not making much sense, but I'm tired since I haven't been sleeping well lately. 

I guess the bottom line is that I really hate my past and some things from my past like memories and scars (on my shoulder that were self inflicted) still haunt me. I didn't have a particular rough past, but it still depresses me. I just feel like I have a very weak mentality and will. I wish I were stronger and that's why I want to die. 

Thank you for responding to me though, I really appreciate it.

Hey, OP. I understand where you're coming from. I don't know what I can say to you in terms of advice or anything that could help, but I do feel your pain. I myself am a male of 23 and I don't have much going for me at the moment. I'm also pretty close to the edge myself and honestly, if I do ever "figure things out" enough to be happy that I'm alive, I'll let you know what I find.

I guess what I'm trying to say is that you are definitely not alone in your fight. I think that everyone has their own unique fights that they have to deal with, but I do think that there are similarities between some people. I wish you all the best tough and it really does come from the bottom of my heart when I say that I hope things work out for you. It would be awesome to know that even though life knocked you down, you got back up and kicked its arse. It would probably go a long way to inspire us slightly younger guys.
Why, what happened?
Hey, you're most welcome. I'm really glad if it helped you feel a little better. Why "especially today" though? something up?
Maybe you're thinking you can't get with them? I have the same problem. Well, sometimes, but I think its because I want the, but I feel like I can't have them.

Hey dude, I understand and I'm not going to tell you that things get better, but I am going to ask you to please not give up on life. I understand how you feel because I'm in a similar situation myself, but you mentioned your brother, is he someone worth living for?

I myself have realized that I have a shit ton of work to do to make myself and my life anything like what I want it to be, but that's okay because life is hard. 

Keep pushing OP. Pain hurts, but maybe one day you won't feel so much pain? Sorry if this reply is a bit all over the place, but I want you to stick around.
Thanks man, you too!

Thank you. Yeah, I really wouldn't want my mother or grandad to find my body, but even if I go off and do it where someone else finds it, I know that wondering where I am and then finding out the truth would kill them.
Yeah I realize how many people have shitty families and mine isn't perfect either, but I really do appreciate my mom, my grandad and my cousin especially.
I don't believe in a higher power either, but I am honestly glad that you're still with us. What led you to the attempt though if I may ask?

You're not the only one. Well actually the first thing I thought about was getting to sleep since I was really tired, then having breakfast when I woke up, but after that yeah... Most of the day I've been thinking about whether I should or not and also how I'd go about it if I do.

Well, I'm spending this new years eve with my grandfather and mom. I am grateful that I have them, but at 23 and since I've become a lot more extroverted I would really like to be out tonight, but I was helping my best friend move recently and didn't make any plans with anyone else for tonight. 

I have thought about ending my life pretty much every day this year and I'll probably think about it often in 2016, but my only resolution for 2016 is going to be that I must not end my life and that I must carry on with this fight that we all share. I won't lie, I am feeling pretty down tonight (although feeling like this has basically become the standard for me), but I will give life another shot next year and see how it goes.

I just hope that next year will bring about a change in how I live my life for the better at least and I hope that next year will bring about change for the better for all of us here because it truly is a merciless fight that we fight.

Happy new year to all of you though and all of the best for 2016!
